source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of 'Network Models and Layers' (PDF 12): the same text in simple Roman Urdu with glossed hard words, a self-check and a recap.

blocks.text: Network models batate hain ke data ek device se doosre device tak organized (tarteeb wale) tareeqe se kaise jata hai. Yeh models communication (baat-cheet) ko mukhtalif layers (tahon) mein baant dete hain. Data transmission (bhejne) mein har layer ka ek khaas kaam hai (jaise Figure 1.13 mein). Layered models networks ko samajhna aur manage karna (sambhalna) aasan banate hain. Yeh network ke masail dhoondne (troubleshooting) mein bhi madad dete hain. Network models networking mein standards (sab ke maane hue namoone) ke taur par istemal hote hain.

blocks.title: Do You Know?
blocks.text: Network models pecheeda network baat-cheet ko aasan qadmon mein samajhne ke liye istemal hote hain.

blocks.prompt: Network models baat-cheet ko layers mein kyun baant'te hain?
blocks.explanation: Taake har layer ek chhota, khaas kaam kare; is se network samajhna, sambhalna aur masail dhoondna aasan ho jata hai.

items: Network models data ke safar ko layers mein baant'te hain; har layer ka khaas kaam; samajhna aur troubleshooting aasan.
